phases.note: Server-side crop execution landed. imagecall.ts's fetchNinaImageReference/callNinaImageModel gain an optional pixel crop-box (sharp().extract before base64-encode); photoshopRun.ts's attemptPhotoshopOnce reads the job's crop_* args, resolves via ninaImageAspectRatioValue + photoshopCropBox, sends the exact chosen aspect_ratio label in both anchor and edit mode, bypassing nearestNinaImageAspectRatio. Null label/box degrades to no-crop, never a failed job. Purely additive. Drift found and fixed: TS 5.9/@types/node 22.20.1 default bare Buffer to Buffer<ArrayBufferLike> not Buffer<ArrayBuffer> -- the plan's code blocks (verified by reading source only, no working toolchain at plan time) didn't anticipate this; fixed with explicit Buffer<ArrayBuffer> annotations, type-only, confined to this phase's 2 files. FLAG for phase 5 (or any later reviewer): if its plan quotes a bare Buffer return type it will hit the same tsc wall. Test state: same 5 pre-existing baseline failures, zero new; independently re-confirmed both root-cause commits are ancestors of origin/main@b88d5bc.
phases.title: Server-side crop execution
